description: This file implements a web interface for viewing and creating requirement specifications within the TestLink project. It manages user input, permissions, rendering of the interface, and interactions with external components like web editors and command objects.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Standard generic class used for various data objects throughout the script.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template engine wrapper used for rendering PHP templates in the web interface.

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: Class representing input parameter configuration for request processing.

classes.name: reqSpecCommands
classes.description: Command class responsible for handling actions related to requirement specifications.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments, pulling from $_SESSION and $_REQUEST.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Handles rendering the user interface based on provided arguments, command results, and templates.

methods.name: initialize_gui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI bean object with default states and permissions.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for viewing and modifying requirement specifications.
